title: KeetScript Package Manifest (pedigree.json)
description: Configuration file for KeetScript projects and packages managed by kattery

name.description: Unique package name (1-64 lowercase chars, letters, digits, '-', '_'; cannot collide with stdlib modules like io, fs, sys, math, time, json, net)

entry.description: Relative path to the main application entry file (defaults to 'src/main.keet')

keety.description: Minimum required compiler version constraint in '>=X.Y.Z' format

dependencies.description: Runtime package dependencies mapping package name to source specification ('git+url[#ref]' or 'path:dir')

devDependencies.description: Development-only package dependencies, skipped during production installs and not inherited by consumers

scripts.description: Named custom shell commands executed via 'kattery run <script>'

workspaces.description: Array of member package directory paths or single-level glob patterns (e.g. ['packages/*', 'apps/cli'])
